title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Product Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Legal Ops Intern
description:
AI Legal Ops Internship at Jumpstart

Location: Remote – Brazil

Compensation: BRL 3,000/month (with growth potential and future equity opportunities)

Hours: 30 per week


About us

We are not just another legal tech startup. We are building the infrastructure to transform the 10-billion-dollar U.S. immigration market, a system that is currently broken, slow and unfair.

Our product utilizes AI to automate legal workflows, predict case outcomes and provide immigrants with something no one else offers: certainty. If their petition is not approved, they get their money back.

We are at the beginning of something massive. We are looking for individuals who want to be part of the journey from 0 to 1, help build a billion-dollar company and own a stake in it.


What We’re Looking For

We do not care if you have worked at a big firm or have a fancy title.

We care if you are:

  • Desperate to learn, willing to move fast, break things and build better.
  • Curious and ambitious, obsessed with the intersection of law, technology and impact.
  • Hungry, driven to help build something huge and take a slice of the upside.
  • Hands-on, ready to work side by side with founders, not sit on the sidelines.


What You’ll Do
  • Collaborate with our legal and AI teams to craft compelling legal petitions and recommendation letters.
  • Structure and organize legal evidence so our AI can produce flawless, high-impact documents.
  • Review and refine AI outputs to ensure legal precision and storytelling excellence.
  • Be part of the core team that is rewriting how immigration is done.


What You Need
  • Law, Computer Science or related degree in progress.
  • Excellent research and writing skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Strong appetite for learning fast, solving problems and building from scratch.
  • Zero ego, high energy.


Why Join Us
  • Be part of a hyper-early-stage company with massive upside.
  • Work directly with founders on a mission to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry.
  • Real ownership and growth, not just busywork.
  • Learn more in six months than most people learn in three years.


This is not a regular internship. If you are hungry, ambitious and want to help build something from the ground up, this is your shot.

title: Desenvolvedor com foco em automações de processos e IA
description:
O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec , NTSec , InfoSec e CloudSec , empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , estamos em constante expansão.


Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™ , temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito .


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!


Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor de novas soluções e integrações com Inteligência Artificial para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:


  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação.
  • Criar e manter fluxos de automação.
  • Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos.
  • Desenvolver scripts e aplicações utilizando a linguagem de programação Python.
  • Propor e implementar soluções técnicas inovadoras para demandas internas e externas.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando Power BI (diferencial).


Requisitos e qualificações:


Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:


  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (completa ou cursando).


Experiência sólida com:


  • Ferramentas e frameworks de LLMs, como OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain ,NLP, RAG, Agentes, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, entre outras.
  • Python (Scripting, APIs, integração de sistemas e com banco de dados).
  • HTML/CSS e JavaScript (desenvolvimento web).
  • Plataforma de automação n8n.
  • Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL (Vector Store).
  • Versionamento de código-fonte utilizando Git.
  • Criação e integração de APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em modelagem de banco de dados e estruturas SQL.


É um diferencial se você tiver:


  • Conhecimentos em Power BI (construção de relatórios e dashboards).
  • Experiência com outras linguagens de automação ou integração de processos (Node.js, JavaScript, etc).
  • Conhecimento em N8N.


E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers ! ⚡

title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Administrador de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Customização e evolução da ferramenta de glossário de termos, alinhando a conceitos de domínios e capacidades do framework BIAN,

Desenvolver e aplicar regras na ferramenta de pré validação de modelos de dados utilizando Regex em C#,

Apoiar o time de Governança de Dados na adoção dos padrões BIAN,

Administrar e modelar dados (conceitual, lógica e física),

Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados,

Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, analistas e equipes de desenvolvimento.


Habilidades e Requisitos


Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados,

Conhecimento prático em automação processos e ferramentas de IA

Conhecimento na esteira CI/CD,

Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem como Erwin ou similares,

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL,

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas,

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (LAMP)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.

  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Senior Systems Administrator (Tableau servers)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Tableau Server Administrator to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the retail/food services/technology area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)


Responsibilities:

  • Ability to setup and configure Tableau servers on various on prem and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with server upgrades and parameter changes
  • Proficiency in connecting Tableau to different data sources and extract data from these sources
  • Manage user permissions, security, and access within Tableau environments
  • Troubleshoot Tableau performance issues and optimizing dashboards


Requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of IT experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Tableau Servers
  • Strong understanding of Tableau architecture, including workbooks, data sources, extract refresh schedules, and server maintenance.
  • Knowledge of Tableau Server features, including scheduling, content management, and server configuration.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) to troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or batch scripting for automating administrative tasks is a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance concepts and experience implementing data security measures in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) is a plus but not required
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to explain and understand problems effectively
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills
  • Time zone: Pacific Time Zone preferred, but flexibility is possible

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms (Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components (CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Mobile - Especialista (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time


Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D



Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

Permanent Remote | Part-time


Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP PLM para se juntar à nossa equipe. Irá analisar processos existentes, configurar módulos como DMS e ECM, garantir integrações entre PLM e outros módulos SAP, além de definir estratégias de migração e conduzir testes funcionais. Principais Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM.
  • Analisar os processos PLM existentes no ECC e projetar soluções otimizadas para o S/4HANA.
  • Configurar módulos SAP PLM, incluindo Document Management System (DMS), Engineering Change Management (ECM), Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management.
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM).
  • Definir estratégia de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e apoiar o UAT (User Acceptance Test) com os usuários-chave do negócio.
  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) durante a execução dos projetos.


Qualificações


  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou superior.
  • Conhecimento de aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

This is a full-time remote role for a DevOps Engineer.   • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

title: Tech Lead - Python e LLMs
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead experiente para liderar o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial conversacional. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por guiar o time de engenharia, definir arquiteturas escaláveis e atuar mão na massa no desenvolvimento de serviços Python e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs) para construção de jornadas conversacionais inteligentes.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Liderar o time técnico, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e arquitetura de software.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações e microserviços em Python.
  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de plataformas conversacionais baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Colaborar com times de produto e IA para desenhar jornadas conversacionais complexas, integradas a sistemas externos.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica, performance e segurança das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time em decisões técnicas e revisões de código.
  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e frameworks que melhorem a produtividade e a escalabilidade da plataforma.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead, Líder Técnico ou Arquiteto de Software.
  • Domínio de Python e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (PEP8, tipagem, testes, etc.).
  • Experiência em projetos com LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral ou similares).
  • Vivência na criação de fluxos/jornadas conversacionais com uso de LLMs, LangChain ou frameworks equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (ex: PostgreSQL, Redis).
  • Familiaridade com Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com orquestração de fluxos conversacionais (Rasa, Botpress, ou soluções proprietárias).
  • Possuir conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e modelagem de contexto conversacional.
  • Tiver experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Já tiver trabalhado com arquitetura orientada a eventos e filas de mensagens (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Dominar containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Tiver interesse em IA aplicada à automação de atendimento e agentes inteligentes.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Advogada Júnior | Compliance e Regulatório BACEN
description:
É uma oportunidade única para você vivenciar o dinamismo de departamentos jurídicos, aperfeiçoar seus conhecimentos técnicos e habilidades comportamentais, experimentar diferentes culturas organizacionais e criar vínculos importantes para a sua carreira.


Seja um secondee!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhamento diário de normativos: acompanhar a publicação de normas regulatórias (especialmente Bacen) e demais legislações aplicáveis ao negócio. Análise do seu conteúdo e comunicação às áreas envolvidas sobre eventuais ajustes necessários, com acompanhamento de planos de ação para adequação;
  • Conformidade regulatória/Roadmap Regulatório: mapeamento das obrigações regulatórias, linha-a-linha, para indicação das implementações necessárias para aderência da empresa (tais como: documentos obrigações, prazos de adequação, riscos e controles relacionados), incluindo acompanhamento de planos de ação para adequação;
  • Gestão de sistemas Bacen: acompanhamento diário dos sistemas (BC Correio, APS/Siscom, STA) bem como manuseio dos demais (Unicad, CRD, Protocolo Digital, RDR). Análise, gestão e atendimento das solicitações recebidas pela empresa;
  • Aplicação de Testes de Aderência: a partir da criação do Roadmap avaliar a efetividade (conformidade/aderência) das áreas da empresa ao arcabouço regulatório aplicável, com a identificação de fragilidades (incluindo controles) e auxílio na elaboração e acompanhamento dos planos de ação para adequação;
  • Elaboração/Revisão de Documentos Corporativos: criação, revisão e atualização dos Documentos Corporativos da empresa, para atendimento de normas (internas, legais e regulatórias); e
  • Relatórios e Controles: elaboração de relatórios e apresentações sobre os temas e informações relacionados à área, bem como acompanhamento de planilhas de controle.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Direito com OAB/SP ativa .
  • Pós-Graduação (cursando ou completa) nas áreas Compliance, Governança Corporativa, será considerado diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com os sistemas do Bacen.
  • Experiência profissional em Instituições de Pagamento, Bancos e/ou instituições autorizadas pelo BCB na área de Compliance.
  • Desejado conhecimento em elaboração de Roadmaps e testes de conformidade.
  • Organização, foco e resiliência para trabalhar em um mercado com rápidas mudanças.


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Tempo de contrato: 03 meses iniciais

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Android
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Sobre o Cargo: Desenvolvedor Android


Responsabilidades:



Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Android para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e manutenção de módulos existentes em nossos aplicativos.

O profissional terá foco inicial em implementar novas features com integrações backend via REST , trabalhando em colaboração com outros desenvolvedores de diferentes camadas da aplicação, sempre com o objetivo de gerar sinergia, qualidade e inovação .

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades em aplicativos Android.
  • Manter e evoluir módulos já existentes.
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços backend via REST.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil.
  • Garantir qualidade do código por meio de boas práticas e testes automatizados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) .
  • Domínio em Java e Kotlin .
  • Conhecimento em Gradle .
  • Aplicação de princípios SOLID .
  • Experiência em Design Patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture) .
  • Criação de testes unitários .
  • Controle de versão com GIT (Gitflow, GitLab) .

title: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation
description:
We are a US startup company headquartered in New York City (


We deliver innovative applications and data solutions to consumers and enterprises. Our projects typically include social, financial, gaming, and shopping elements.


We are looking for highly talented, motivated, and responsible engineers. We value people who are able to understand business needs and solve difficult problems, as well as people who are willing to learn new things and take responsibility for delivering great results.


We provide an exciting environment with others who share a passion for excellence. Come meet us and see for yourself if you want to join a growing international business.


Position: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation


Work on the next generation of healthcare and factory automation applications and services powered by AI and excellent experiences. Join a team of experienced startup developers building out highly scalable service architectures to radically change the status quo in healthcare and factory automation.


Desirable technology experience:

● Python / Go

● gRPC / Protocol Buffers

● React.js / React Native / Vue

● PostgreSQL / SQL Server

● AWS serverless technologies: Lambda, SQS, SNS, etc.

● Applications of LLM and ML AI technologies


Desirable subject matter expertise:

Healthcare and factory automation. Experience with other insurance markets. Fintech, particularly trading and portfolio applications for financial advisors and their investors.


Minimum Applicant Requirements:

● Excellent command of English, written and spoken

● Ability to produce tested applications from business requirements

● Ability to work independently and as a team member

● Self-starting, well-organized, and enthusiastic work style

● At least 8+ years of working experience in relevant technologies


Additional requirements:

This position requires a background check of your work and life experience by a 3rd party.


Benefits:

● Competitive compensation

● Flexible work/life balance

● Work with the latest technologies

● Work with a small, intense, and fun team


Applicant Questions

SUBMISSIONS WITHOUT ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED:

If you are interested in the position, please compose a written introduction to yourself in the English language, including answers to the questions below, as well as anything else we should know, and send it along with your resume.


  • When can you start?
  • How many years have you worked full-time as a Full Stack Developer?
  • What hourly rate do you charge for full-time contract jobs?
  • Please write a paragraph about your favorite past project. Be sure to tell us why you liked it.


Due to the number of applications from fake identities, you will be required to present an ID (Passport or Driver’s License) sufficient to verify your identity at the beginning of your first interview.

title: Consultor Basis
description:
Consultor SAP Basis Sênior

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: UK Time (10 AM – 19 PM)


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Administrar e gerenciar o ambiente SAP, incluindo instalação, configuração, monitoramento e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, PI/PO, etc.).

• Realizar atualizações, migrações e patches em sistemas SAP.

• Gerenciar a configuração e administração de usuários, segurança, perfis e autorizações.

• Planejar e executar tarefas de backup, recuperação de desastres e garantir a continuidade dos negócios.

• Realizar monitoramento de desempenho, análise e ajuste fino dos sistemas SAP.

• Colaborar com equipes de projeto para implementar soluções SAP em ambientes de desenvolvimento, teste e produção.

• Suporte a auditorias de segurança e conformidade, garantindo que as práticas recomendadas sejam seguidas.

• Prover suporte técnico de alta qualidade para a equipe interna e stakeholders.

• Documentar procedimentos e melhores práticas para a operação e administração dos sistemas SAP.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência mínima de 10 anos como Consultor SAP Basis, com histórico comprovado em ambientes complexos.

• Proficiência em instalação, atualização e administração de diferentes componentes do SAP (ABAP, JAVA, NetWeaver, HANA, etc.).

• Suporte e administração de bases de dados SAP HANA, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase ASE, incluindo a execução de tuning de performance e troubleshooting.

• Configuração e gerenciamento de clusters de alta disponibilidade e soluções de failover em ambientes SAP.

• Experiência com SAP Solution Manager.

• Experiência em administração de ambientes SAP em cloud, como AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud Platform.

• Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais, como Linux, Windows e UNIX.

• Experiência com integração de SAP com Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO) e outras soluções de segurança.

• Forte compreensão de infraestrutura de TI, incluindo redes, servidores e storage.

• Habilidades em resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.

• Certificação SAP Basis e/ou SAP HANA será um diferencial.

• Inglês fluente, tanto escrito quanto falado.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e organização.

• Orientado a detalhes com forte habilidade analítica.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
description:
Who are we:

Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.

We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.

With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.

Neotalent, the responsive people.

Find out more about us at


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Dynamics 365 CE Solution Architect / CRM Consultant to join one of our biggest clients, a global technology consultancy focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions across industries.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead a strategic technical assessment, contribute to the simplification and optimisation of a complex CRM ecosystem, and help define the roadmap for long-term transformation, we have the ideal project for your career.

Come energize your future with us!


Location: Full-remote from Brazil (English fluency required)


What you will do:

• Evaluate the current Dynamics 365 CE architecture, customizations, entity model, and configuration

• Identify sources of complexity, performance bottlenecks, and fragility

• Recommend strategies to simplify the architecture and reduce technical debt

• Analyse integrations including Dataverse OData APIs, Outbound Event Messages, and ESB

• Review data flows, reconciliation challenges, and environment promotion processes

• Propose robust data governance and integration patterns

• Assess Azure DevOps pipelines and multi-environment deployment practices

• Recommend automation improvements for deployment reliability

• Review managed service framework and suggest future support models

• Produce findings and recommendations report

• Define short-term stabilisation and medium-term optimisation roadmap

• Prepare proposal for next-phase implementation


What you are like:

• Senior-level expertise in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales Enterprise module)

• Strong experience with integration technologies: Dataverse APIs, ESB messaging, web services

• Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies

• Proven experience in CRM architecture rationalisation and modernisation

• Experience assessing managed service models and support optimisation

• Advanced problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

• Ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations

• Strong understanding of data modelling, reconciliation, and automation

• Comfortable working in fast-paced discovery phases (2–3 weeks)

• Proactive and independent, with strong alignment capabilities


Why join us:

• Work on challenging projects for big clients

• Learn more about emerging technologies

• Possibility of working remotely

• Design your career plan

• Access to continuous training and certifications

• Evolve through our internal mobility program

• … and much more!

title: SR Desenvolvimento Back-end (Golang)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência sólida com Golang em ambientes produtivos.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços
  • Protocolos de API GraphQL e RestFul
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL .
  • Prática com Docker e Kubernetes para construção e orquestração de containers.
  • Vivência com AWS e seus principais serviços (EC2, S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, etc).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código com Git.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e colaborativos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Node.js ou vontade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas.
  • Familiaridade com React Native e integração backend-mobile.
  • Prática com observabilidade (monitoramento, métricas, alertas).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e melhores práticas de proteção de dados.
  • Experiência prévia com ferramentas como CI/CD, Terraform ou similares.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!

title: JD Edwards Developer - English - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone


Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone


Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills

title: Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior
description:
*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Código da Vaga #


Sua missão no time será:

Atuar com protagonismo no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções back-end escaláveis e robustas, com foco em Java e suas principais frameworks. Espera-se que você tenha autonomia para propor e implementar soluções técnicas, liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e participar de decisões arquiteturais. Também será responsável por apoiar tecnicamente os demais desenvolvedores, contribuindo para a evolução do time e das práticas de engenharia.


O que você precisa ter:

• Sólida experiência com Java e seus frameworks principais (Spring Boot, JPA, Lambdas, Functions);

• Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB);

• Experiência com soluções de cache (Redis, Memcached ou similares);

• Vivência com mensageria (RabbitMQ e/ou Kafka);

• Experiência em microsserviços utilizando Spring Boot, Docker e Kubernetes;

• Conhecimento avançado em versionamento, pipelines CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia;

• Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente e apoiar desenvolvedores menos experientes;

• Ensino superior completo;

• Modelo de trabalho remoto.
